transcript: Speaker A: Ente husband-nnu nalla oru job-aa. Enikku English polum samsarikkan pattunnilla. Ella karyathinte artham ennodu chodhikkunnalle. Sathyam paranjal avar thettayirunnilla. Njan Malayalam medium-ilaanu padichathu. English manassilakumayirunnu pakshe samsarikkan varumpol confidence poorrnmayum pokumayirunnu. Pakshe enikku job cheyyanamayirunnu. Athukondu njan aarodum parayathe SpeakX app download cheythu. Ithil oru AI English teacher undu. Husband office-il pokumpol njan divasavum avarodu samsarichu practice cheyumayirunnu. Ente pronunciation thettiyalum avar chirikkilla. Ente grammar thettukal kandittu parihasikkukayumilla. Randu aazhchakullil ente English first class aayi. Kazhinja aazhcha njan interview attend cheythu, muzhuvanum English-il. Pinne oru karyam koodi, enikku job kitti. Ningalkkum ningalude English nannakkanamennundenkil SpeakX app download cheyyoo. [My husband has a good job. I can't even speak English. He asks me the meaning of everything. To be honest, they weren't wrong. I studied in Malayalam medium. I could understand English, but when it came to speaking, my confidence would completely go. But I wanted to do a job. So, without telling anyone, I downloaded the SpeakX app. There is an AI English teacher in it. When my husband went to the office, I used to practice speaking with them every day. Even if my pronunciation was wrong, they wouldn't laugh. They wouldn't mock me for my grammar mistakes. Within two weeks, my English became first class. Last week I attended an interview, entirely in English. And one more thing, I got the job. If you also want to improve your English, download the SpeakX app.]

She explains how she used the SpeakX app's AI teacher to practice privately while her husband was at work, leading to a successful job interview.
